name: Asset cache bust
description: Overrides the core CSS/JS collection renderers to re-add a cache-busting query string to aggregated CSS and JS.
project_description: Asset cache bust overrides Drupal core's CSSCollectionRenderer and JsCollectionRenderer services to always append a cache-busting query string to aggregated CSS and JS asset URLs. This effectively undoes the core change from https://www.drupal.org/project/drupal/issues/3019393. The query string value changes with each update or full cache clear, so browsers and CDNs are forced to fetch the new aggregate instead of serving a stale or incomplete cached copy. It requires no configuration and provides no routes, permissions, or settings.
